name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport PR began with a childhood spent glued to the television, watching rally legends navigate the winding Welsh countryside. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he honed his skills at a local motorsport magazine, quickly rising through the ranks to become their lead reporter. His ability to craft compelling narratives and build strong relationships landed him a coveted position with Eurofarma RC.

As a PR Officer, Rhys is known for his meticulous approach and ability to anticipate potential crises. He believes in transparency and open communication, fostering trust with both the media and the team's fanbase. Rhys's calm demeanor under pressure, coupled with his understanding of the technical aspects of racing, makes him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring that Eurofarma RC's message is always clear, consistent, and compelling.

What truly sets Rhys apart is his knack for identifying and capitalizing on emerging trends in digital media, ensuring Eurofarma RC remains at the forefront of motorsport engagement. He's also fluent in Portuguese, allowing him to directly communicate with the Eurofarma team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a lean build and an attentive gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a specific brand of Welsh tea he drinks before every race.
Checks the weather forecast obsessively, regardless of whether the race is indoors or outdoors.
